items.name: stellify-base
items.title: StellifyIT design tokens
items.description: StellifyIT design tokens v2: tonal surfaces, status and chart palettes, 4/8px radii, solid focus outline, one overlay shadow, motion, Inter + Geist Mono (light + dark, oklch). Install first.

light.font-mono: 'Geist Mono Variable', 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace

items.name: trend-indicator
items.title: TrendIndicator
items.description: Up/down/flat arrow with a formatted change and a semantic tone (up = success, down = danger; invertible for costs). Direction can be derived from a numeric change with a flat threshold. The required label is what screen readers read; copy via props.

items.name: progress-ring
items.title: ProgressRing
items.description: SVG circular progress indicator. value/max/size/strokeWidth via props, themed with currentColor + muted track.

items.name: section-card
items.title: SectionCard
items.description: Card with a titled header, optional description, header actions slot and content area. Common panel shell.

items.name: status-badge
items.title: StatusBadge
items.description: Badge whose tone is a status (success/warning/danger/info/neutral); `appearance="plain"` for icon + text. Thin wrapper over badge.

items.name: confirm-dialog
items.title: ConfirmDialog
items.description: Controlled confirmation dialog over AlertDialog. All copy via props; destructive flag for dangerous actions; returnFocusRef for dialogs opened from a menu.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: AlertDialog
items.description: Radix alert dialog (vendored from shadcn so `confirm-dialog` never resolves upstream). Emits data-slot.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: Table primitives (vendored from shadcn so `data-table` never resolves upstream). Emits data-slot.

items.name: button
items.title: Button (StellifyIT)
items.description: Shadcn-compatible button: primary (brand) / secondary (tonal) / base (no fill) + destructive/success/warning/info/link, no borders or shadows. `loading` shows the Spinner; CRUD `mode` (create/edit/finish) injects color and icon. default/lg/icon are 44px on touch screens. Overwrites ui/button.

items.name: input
items.title: Input (StellifyIT)
items.description: Filled input (bg-field) with a 3:1 underline (field-edge), never an outline box; aria-invalid turns it danger-subtle. Focus is the global outline. API-compatible; overwrites ui/input.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: Form-control wrapper: label, control, then help or error. Owns htmlFor / aria-invalid / aria-describedby / required for any control (input, textarea, select, number-input, pickers).

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: The one spinner: a ring in the current color, sizes sm/md/lg, `decorative` inside busy buttons. Used by button, loading-spinner and loading-state.

items.name: segmented-control
items.title: SegmentedControl
items.description: Pick one of 2-5 options; the ink indicator slides and changes course mid-move when you click again (interruptible CSS transition). radiogroup, arrows/Home/End, roving tabindex. accessibleLabel for short labels ("es" → Español), size lg = 44px. Exports useSlidingIndicator (used by tabs).

items.name: text-field
items.title: TextField
items.description: Field + Input in one: label, error/help and optional leading/trailing icons. Copy via props.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge (StellifyIT)
items.description: One badge for labels and states: `tone` (neutral/brand/success/warning/danger/info) x `appearance` (subtle/solid/plain), `icon`, `withDot`, `size` (default | xs), `uppercase` (mono caps). shadcn `variant` names still work. Emits data-slot.

items.name: card
items.title: Card (StellifyIT)
items.description: Raised area: surface-2, no border or shadow, 8px radius. Parts as named exports or Card.Header / Title / Description / Content / Footer. Fields inside switch to surface-3. Overwrites ui/card.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog (StellifyIT)
items.description: Standard shadcn dialog primitive, shipped under @stellify for apps without shadcn. Close button: labels.close ("Cerrar"), 32px target, 44px on touch. Overwrites ui/dialog.

items.name: select
items.title: Select (StellifyIT)
items.description: Standard shadcn select primitive, shipped under @stellify for apps without shadcn. Overwrites ui/select.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: Searchable select (WAI-ARIA combobox + listbox): single or multiple (chips), groups, creatable, accent-insensitive filter, full keyboard, 44px rows on touch. Works as the control inside Field.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs (StellifyIT)
items.description: Radix tabs. Default: segmented look with a sliding, interruptible ink indicator. `TabsList variant="plain"`: text tabs with a sliding underline. Overwrites ui/tabs. Emits data-slot.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox (StellifyIT)
items.description: Standard shadcn checkbox primitive, shipped under @stellify for apps without shadcn. Overwrites ui/checkbox.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider (StellifyIT)
items.description: Standard shadcn slider primitive (Radix), single or range thumbs, shipped under @stellify. Overwrites ui/slider.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch (StellifyIT)
items.description: Standard shadcn switch primitive, shipped under @stellify for apps without shadcn. Overwrites ui/switch.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip (StellifyIT)
items.description: Standard shadcn tooltip primitive, shipped under @stellify for apps without shadcn. Overwrites ui/tooltip.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: DropdownMenu (StellifyIT)
items.description: Standard shadcn dropdown-menu primitive, shipped under @stellify for apps without shadcn. Overwrites ui/dropdown-menu.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover (StellifyIT)
items.description: Standard shadcn popover primitive, shipped under @stellify for apps without shadcn. Overwrites ui/popover.

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar (StellifyIT)
items.description: Standard shadcn calendar primitive, shipped under @stellify for apps without shadcn. Overwrites ui/calendar.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea (StellifyIT)
items.description: Filled textarea with a 3:1 underline; `autoResize` grows with the content, shrinks back when cleared (also programmatically) and scrolls past `maxHeight`. aria-invalid turns it danger-subtle. Emits data-slot.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator (StellifyIT)
items.description: Standard shadcn separator primitive, shipped under @stellify for apps without shadcn. Overwrites ui/separator.

items.name: label
items.title: Label (StellifyIT)
items.description: Standard shadcn label primitive, shipped under @stellify for apps without shadcn. Overwrites ui/label.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress (StellifyIT)
items.description: Standard shadcn progress primitive, shipped under @stellify for apps without shadcn. Overwrites ui/progress. `size="sm"`: thin bar on a neutral track.

items.name: form
items.title: Form (StellifyIT)
items.description: Standard shadcn form primitive, shipped under @stellify for apps without shadcn. Overwrites ui/form.

items.name: time-range-selector
items.title: TimeRangeSelector
items.description: Time-range picker (7d/30d/90d/Todo) on segmented-control + getRangeBounds() helper. labels prop. For chart headers.

items.name: date-picker-field
items.title: DatePickerField
items.description: Button + calendar popover date field. Emits ISO YYYY-MM-DD. Locale via prop.

items.name: loading-spinner
items.title: LoadingSpinner
items.description: Spinner centered in its container or the viewport (`fullScreen`). size sm/md/lg; label defaults to "Cargando".

items.name: date-range-picker
items.title: DateRangePicker
items.description: Range calendar popover with presets, Apply/Cancel, side-by-side months, and an optional date↔datetime switch that unlocks start/end time pickers (default 00:00). Emits ISO { from, to } (with THH:mm when time is on).

items.name: time-picker
items.title: TimePicker
items.description: Hour + minute selects (+ AM/PM unless use24Hour). Controlled, emits 24h 'HH:mm'. minuteStep configurable.

items.name: overflow-marquee
items.title: OverflowMarquee
items.description: Truncates with an ellipsis at rest and, only when the text actually overflows, slides horizontally on hover/focus to reveal the full string, easing back on leave. Self-contained (measures its own overflow, pure CSS transform, no Tailwind config). Honors reduced motion; keeps a native title fallback.

items.name: number-input
items.title: NumberInput
items.description: Controlled numeric input (empty = null) with a vertical ± stepper, min/max clamping and translatable button labels.

items.name: choice-card
items.title: ChoiceCard
items.description: Single-choice block options (Radix radio group): title + description, selected = primary border + check.

items.name: textarea-field
items.title: TextareaField
items.description: Field + Textarea: the multi-line sibling of text-field.

items.name: chip
items.title: Chip
items.description: Small neutral tag (e.g. a detected signal); optional `onRemove` adds an accessible remove button.

items.name: collapse-toggle
items.title: CollapseToggle
items.description: Text button that collapses/expands a region (aria-expanded, aria-controls).

items.name: loading-state
items.title: LoadingState
items.description: Long-running work: title + text + spinner, optional "n de N" progress (role=status).

items.name: chart-card
items.title: ChartCard
items.description: Card shell for charts with loading skeleton, empty and error states, header actions slot. `labels.retry` defaults to "Reintentar".

items.name: chart
items.title: Chart (StellifyIT)
items.description: shadcn chart primitive: ChartContainer/ChartTooltip/ChartLegend over Recharts, wired to stellify-base chart tokens. Overwrites ui/chart.

items.name: chart-area
items.title: Area chart
items.description: Area chart built on the chart primitive + Recharts, using stellify-base chart-N tokens. Demo data inside — edit freely.

items.name: chart-bar
items.title: Bar chart
items.description: Bar chart built on the chart primitive + Recharts, using stellify-base chart-N tokens. Demo data inside — edit freely.

items.name: chart-line
items.title: Line chart
items.description: Line chart built on the chart primitive + Recharts 3, using stellify-base chart-N tokens. Optional per-series dashes, linear curve, Y axis and X formatter. Demo data inside.

items.name: chart-pie
items.title: Pie / donut chart
items.description: Pie / donut chart built on the chart primitive + Recharts, using stellify-base chart-N tokens. Demo data inside — edit freely.

items.name: chart-radar
items.title: Radar chart
items.description: Radar chart built on the chart primitive + Recharts, using stellify-base chart-N tokens. Demo data inside — edit freely.

items.name: chart-radial
items.title: Radial chart
items.description: Radial chart built on the chart primitive + Recharts, using stellify-base chart-N tokens. Demo data inside — edit freely.

items.name: chart-formatters
items.title: chart-formatters
items.description: Intl-based value/currency/date/number formatters for chart tooltips, legends and axis ticks. Pure, no React.

items.name: use-series-toggle
items.title: useSeriesToggle
items.description: Visibility state for an interactive chart legend (click series to show/hide).

items.name: data-table
items.title: DataTable
items.description: Presentational, controlled table in a rounded frame: tinted header, hairline rows, footer inside. Sort, per-column header filters (`filter` + `filters`/`onFilterChange`), row selection with select-all and a bulk-actions bar, row actions, loading skeleton, empty state. Right-aligned columns use tabular mono figures. Spanish `labels`.

items.name: data-table-pagination
items.title: DataTablePagination
items.description: Controlled pagination: rows per page, "1–10 de 42" range and numbered pages with gaps. Spanish `labels`.

items.name: data-table-toolbar
items.title: DataTableToolbar
items.description: Search row for data-table with `filters` and `actions` slots and children for active-filter chips. Spanish `labels`.

items.name: data-table-mobile
items.title: DataTableMobile
items.description: Card-per-row mobile view reusing data-table's columns. Pair with data-table behind a breakpoint. Includes loading skeletons + empty slot.

items.name: data-table-filters
items.title: DataTableFilters
items.description: Filter type system for DataTable: 10 filter kinds, operators, state shapes, type guards and factory helpers. No UI. Also `applyFilters` / `matchesFilter` / `countActiveFilters` for in-memory rows.

items.name: data-table-filter-widget
items.title: DataTableFilterWidget
items.description: Renders the control for one filter definition — text, number, ranges, date, datetime, select, multiselect and async column values.

items.name: data-table-column-filter
items.title: DataTableColumnFilter
items.description: Header filter button (tinted while active) opening the column's FilterWidget in a popover.

items.name: data-table-active-filters
items.title: DataTableActiveFilters
items.description: Active-filter chips: column + value, click to edit, ✕ to clear, optional "Limpiar filtros". Spanish `labels`.

items.name: data-table-advanced-filters
items.title: DataTableAdvancedFilters
items.description: "Filtros" button with an active-count badge opening a panel with every filterable column's widget; edits apply live, with per-field reset and "Limpiar todo". Spanish `labels`.

items.name: metric-card
items.title: MetricCard
items.description: KPI card on a tonal surface: label, value in tabular mono, unit, delta with trend arrow, accent icon chip (neutral/brand/success/warning/danger/info; v1 hue names still map). invertDelta flips good/bad; tone colors the value; details adds label/value rows.

items.name: page-header
items.title: PageHeader
items.description: Page title + optional description + actions slot. Presentational only (no auth/theme/locale logic). Optional `eyebrow` line above the title.

items.name: illustration
items.title: Illustration
items.description: 21 public-domain plates (botanical, fauna, objects; Artvee) as ink-only alpha masks drawn in a token color (brand by default), so each product sees them in its own brand, light and dark. Manifest with title, artist, date and source. WebPs load from jsDelivr or your own /illustrations folder via IllustrationProvider.

items.name: empty-state
items.title: EmptyState
items.description: Centered empty/placeholder block: a public-domain plate (or an icon), title, description and optional action.

items.name: app-shell
items.title: AppShell
items.description: App frame: fixed left sidebar (collapsible), optional top bar, scrollable main.

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: Vertical app nav: Sidebar, SidebarGroup, SidebarGroupLabel, SidebarItem (icon, active = aria-current, trailing slot, asChild for router links).

items.name: site-nav
items.title: SiteNav
items.description: Public site navigation with an accessible mobile menu (focus trap, Escape to close). Optional mega-menu: desktop triggers open MegaMenuPanels (hover, click, ArrowDown; Escape/outside/blur close), mobile becomes a full-screen drill-down sheet (portal, focus trap, scroll lock, inert off-screen pane, actions dock). Links are real anchors so they stay crawlable.

items.name: use-mega-menu
items.title: useMegaMenu
items.description: Mega-menu open/close state: instant open, delayed close for diagonal mouse moves, and a closing state kept until the exit animation finishes. No animation library. Exports megaMenuPanelId.

items.name: use-mega-menu-motion
items.title: useMegaMenuMotion
items.description: GSAP motion for MegaMenuPanel: background grows down, content unclips, items stagger in; category switch re-staggers only; faster fold-up on close. Also a render-nothing MegaMenuMotion component for SiteNav's menuMotion prop. Honors reduced motion.

items.name: nav-preview-card
items.title: NavPreviewCard
items.description: Mega-menu preview card: photo with scrim or a dark panel with title, summary and an optional decoration (FacetGrid included). Out of the tab order and a11y tree; renderLink for client routers.

items.name: mega-menu-panel
items.title: MegaMenuPanel
items.description: Full-width mega-menu panel: up to three labelled link columns, optional CTA, and preview cards that follow the hovered/focused link. Always in the DOM (hidden) so links prerender; data-nav-* hooks for useMegaMenuMotion or a CSS fade.

items.name: site-chat
items.title: SiteChat
items.description: Public chat panel, degraded-first: renders a FAQ block by default and gains a composer when a service is available. Never shows a raw error or an indefinite spinner. Copy via `labels` (Spanish defaults).

items.name: site-footer
items.title: SiteFooter
items.description: Site footer with grouped link columns and a legal line. Real anchors — it doubles as the crawlable link graph.

items.name: long-form-article
items.title: LongFormArticle
items.description: Long-form page body: intro, optional status badge and figures, h2 sections with pull-outs, stack chips and related links. Content is plain strings, never markup.

items.name: key-takeaways
items.title: KeyTakeaways
items.description: "En resumen" callout: an aside labelled by its h2 with a list of self-contained takeaways. Fits between the h1 intro and the first h2. Renders nothing when empty.

items.name: faq-list
items.title: FaqList
items.description: FAQ section built on native details/summary (zero JS, answers present in the HTML for crawlers) plus a faqPageJsonLd() helper for schema.org FAQPage.

items.name: inline-cta
items.title: InlineCta
items.description: Compact bordered card with one sentence and a primary button-styled link. Meant to sit after a page's first paragraph.

items.name: sticky-cta
items.title: StickyCta
items.description: Mobile-only fixed bottom CTA bar (z-40, safe-area aware) with an optional secondary action (e.g. tel:) and an in-flow spacer so it never covers the footer.

items.name: share-button
items.title: ShareButton
items.description: Share button: native share sheet when available (checked on click), otherwise a popover with copy-link and LinkedIn/WhatsApp/X/email intent links. No third-party scripts.

items.name: cookie-consent
items.title: CookieConsent
items.description: Presentational, non-modal analytics-cookie banner (z-50). Accept and Reject have equal weight; no close button that implies consent. Copy via `labels` (Spanish defaults).

items.name: message-bubble
items.title: MessageBubble
items.description: One chat message as an <article> named by a hidden heading (level prop): user = rounded tonal bubble (max 80%) on the right, assistant = document on the left. meta/footer slots; hides streaming text from assistive tech.

items.name: markdown-message
items.title: MarkdownMessage
items.description: Assistant reply from Markdown (GFM): code blocks with copy, tables, lists; raw HTML skipped, images reduced to alt text, headings as bold paragraphs (outline stays intact). Smooth reveal + caret while streaming. labels.

items.name: tool-activity
items.title: ToolActivity
items.description: Compact lines for the tools a turn used: status by icon shape + text (spinner, check, cross), native <details> disclosure for the detail, duration in mono.

items.name: turn-status
items.title: TurnStatus
items.description: Where a chat turn stands (thinking, responding, tool, cancelled, error) as text + an icon whose shape changes. Purely visual: announce through your own live region.

items.name: chat-composer
items.title: ChatComposer
items.description: Message box as one card (T3 Code-style): auto-growing textarea on top, footer with `leading` settings (model picker, toggles via ChatComposerControl) and `controls` + round send/stop on the right. Enter sends, Shift+Enter newline (IME-safe), Escape stops; focus outlines the card; private tone; notice line below.

items.name: conversation-list
items.title: ConversationList
items.description: Conversation history for a sidebar in compact rows: grouped under headings (Hoy, Ayer…), relative time at the row end that gives way to the row menu (rename in place, delete) on hover/focus, menu always visible on touch; current one with aria-current + weight + background; accent-insensitive `query` filter; optional tag badge. labels.

items.name: chat-sidebar
items.title: ChatSidebar
items.description: Left column of a chat app (T3 Code-style): brand + collapse (or close in a drawer), new-conversation row with shortcut hint, search box that filters as you type (Escape clears), scrolling list slot, footer. A <nav> landmark. labels.

items.name: side-drawer
items.title: SideDrawer
items.description: Modal panel from the left or right edge (a sidebar's mobile form): focus trap, Escape and backdrop close, scroll lock, focus return, safe areas.

items.name: keyboard-shortcuts-dialog
items.title: KeyboardShortcutsDialog
items.description: The "?" dialog: every shortcut as a description list with <kbd> keys and alternatives. Built on dialog; labels (title, or, close).

items.name: pairing-qr
items.title: PairingQr
items.description: Device-pairing QR (always black on white with a quiet zone) + the code as text + a countdown timer; announces expiry once and offers a new code. qrcode is loaded lazily. labels.

items.name: mic-button
items.title: MicButton
items.description: Push-to-talk toggle for a composer (aria-pressed, running clock while recording, spinner while transcribing, aria-keyshortcuts) + StopSpeakingButton for read-aloud. labels.

items.name: message-actions
items.title: MessageActions
items.description: Toolbar under a message: copy (announced), regenerate, fork, delete; arrow keys move; quiet until hover/focus on pointer devices, always visible on touch. labels.

items.name: model-picker
items.title: ModelPicker
items.description: Model picker: search (prefix > word start > substring), rail of groups with Favorites and live status (off/busy/limited by shape + text), rows with private lock, badges, context, vision/tools, measured speed, star, Alt+1…9. Unavailable models listed with their reason. Popover on desktop, bottom sheet on touch. Announces the choice. labels.

items.name: intelui-types
items.title: intelUI types
items.description: Shared presentational types for the intelUI assistant pieces (messages, tabs, conversations, actions). Engine-agnostic.

items.name: intelui-pill
items.title: InteluiPill
items.description: Bottom-of-sidebar assistant pill: nav-item styling, fading label, highlighted when intelUI is active. Opens the assistant dropdown. Props-only.

items.name: intelui-conversation-list
items.title: InteluiConversationList
items.description: Selectable conversation history list with per-row delete cross (reveals on hover). Props-only, i18n-agnostic.

items.name: intelui-tabs
items.title: InteluiTabs
items.description: Horizontal scrollable tab strip for open conversations: per-tab close cross + a new-conversation button. Props-only.

items.name: intelui-chat-panel
items.title: InteluiChatPanel
items.description: Upward-expanding transcript panel: context header, tab strip, suggestion chips and message log. max-height transition. Props-only.

items.name: intelui-floating-bar
items.title: InteluiFloatingBar
items.description: Floating assistant input bar: portaled, anchored to the sidebar edge via --intelui-sidebar-w, grows from the icon. Send/stop (spinner+cancel), focus suggestions, caret-up chat panel. Props-only.

items.name: intelui-dropdown
items.title: InteluiDropdown
items.description: Assistant popover content in two groups: Actions (Sparkles/Zap) and Conversations (Clock, deletable history), plus the intelUI switch. Props-only.

items.name: intelui-highlight
items.title: intelUI highlight layer
items.description: Assistant-actionable highlight: --intelui-accent token + a soft persistent outline on [data-intelui-actionable], reinforced on hover/focus and when [data-selected]. Respects reduced motion. Pairs with the Actionable wrapper.

items.name: actionable
items.title: Actionable
items.description: Domain-agnostic wrapper that marks an entity as assistant-actionable: paints data-intelui-actionable / data-intelui-type / data-selected for the intelui-highlight layer. asChild (Slot) merges markers onto the child without an extra node or competing handlers. Props-only.

items.name: intelui-chip
items.title: InteluiChip
items.description: Removable selected-entity chip for the assistant input: label + trailing ✕, --intelui-accent border, data-intelui-type accent. Props-only.

items.name: animated-text
items.title: AnimatedText
items.description: Text that rises out of a mask line by line or word by word when it enters the viewport (GSAP SplitText + ScrollTrigger). Markup is the final text; no motion under reduced motion.

items.name: clip-reveal
items.title: ClipReveal
items.description: Panel that opens from a rounded inset clip-path to full size as it scrolls in, scrubbed (GSAP ScrollTrigger). Markup is the open state; reduced motion shows it whole.

items.name: scroll-reveal
items.title: ScrollReveal
items.description: Section whose background widens from an inset rounded card to full width (top corners flattening) as it scrolls to the top. Only the background layer moves (GSAP ScrollTrigger).

items.name: scrub-words
items.title: ScrubWords
items.description: Large statement whose words light up one by one, scrubbed to the scroll (GSAP SplitText + ScrollTrigger). Markup is the lit text.

items.name: marquee
items.title: Marquee
items.description: Infinite horizontal marquee of short entries: rendered twice for a seamless loop, read once by screen readers, Web Animations API (no keyframes to install), pauses on hover, off under reduced motion.

items.name: stagger
items.title: Stagger
items.description: Staggered entrance for arriving content: each child fades and rises in turn (--stagger-step, capped so long lists settle fast). Adds a class and delay to your own markup; off under reduced motion.

items.name: use-persisted-state
items.title: usePersistedState
items.description: useState that persists to localStorage (JSON-serialized), SSR-safe.

items.name: use-view-transition
items.title: useViewTransition
items.description: Shared element transitions with the View Transitions API: run a state change through it and elements with the same view-transition-name morph between views. Instant fallback without the API or under reduced motion.

items.name: use-prefers-reduced-motion
items.title: usePrefersReducedMotion
items.description: Reactive prefers-reduced-motion flag. Prerender-safe (false on the server, re-evaluated on the client).

items.name: use-focus-trap
items.title: useFocusTrap
items.description: Keeps focus inside an element while active: Tab/Shift+Tab wrap, escaped focus is pulled back, Escape callback, optional initial focus, body scroll lock and focus restore. Skips inert/hidden subtrees. Exports getFocusables.

items.name: use-smooth-text
items.title: useSmoothText
items.description: Reveals a streamed string a few characters per frame, catching up with the backlog; instant with reduced motion or when the text is replaced.

items.name: utils
items.title: cn utility
items.description: `cn()` = clsx + tailwind-merge. Owned by this registry so installs never pull shadcn's upstream `utils`.
